data.creator_notes:
[Massive Overhaul]
A fully fleshed out character card for the optimistic and questionably close to her brother Karen Araragi. I have put an emphasis on retaining her odd gesturing, posing, dialogue and an attempt to keep the strong sense of story building that the series is known for. For this card you will be taking place of the shows main focus, Koyomi Araragi. 

I have provided four setups for your story to start off from. The first is word by word the lead up to the infamous "toothbrush scene" of a more 🔥 way of starting and the second being from "Mayoi Snail" where Karen and Koyomi get in a fight about mother's day. I've provided two other simple setups for you to take things in any direction you want to without scenario restrictions.

[I cringed as I opened this card for the first time in a while and knew Instantly something had to be done. I love the little egg pinned fire sister too much to keep it as it was.
